{{Attr|Basic Freeze}} |versus_send_cost = {{Money|34,000}} |versus_wave_unlock = 47 |ability1 = ''''{{WikiAb|Molten Rock Throw}}''' - The '''Tank 2''' picks up a boulder and throws it at nearby towers, stunning towers hit. }} {{QuoteContainer| {{QuoteBox|Fire tank!!!|Beginning of Wave 46}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Tank 2''' was a stronger form of the [[Tank|Tank 1]]. It had the same speed as the [[Tank|Tank 1]] while also having much more health than it. The '''Tank 2''' was also immune to the [[Pyromancer]], meaning that it was harder to slow down. ==Appearance== The '''Tank 2''' was the same size as [[Tank|Tank 1]]. The '''Tank 2''' had glowing yellow eyes, a drooling zombie face and maroon skin. The '''Tank 2''' also had smoke emitting from its torso with a magma trail being left when it walked, similar to the [[Molten Boss]]. It had long muscular arms and walked slightly hunchbacked. ==Strategy== *The '''Tank 2''' is immune to the [[Pyromancer]], so if you want to slow the '''Tank 2''' down, then you will have to use the [[Freezer]]. **The [[Pyromancer]] will not even target the '''Tank 2'''. *All [[units]] (such as those from the [[Military Base]] and [[Crook Boss]]) are destroyed when hit by rocks from the '''Tank 2'''. *You can use towers that do not value as much as cheap distractions, such as the [[Scout]] or [[Pyromancer]]. **This makes the '''Tank 2''' immobilised for a while, allowing other towers that are not stunned to attack it. *Towers with a fast firerate, such as the [[Minigunner]] or [[Turret]], are recommended to kill the '''Tank 2'''. **The [[Rocketeer|Rocketer]] can also be used as '''Tanks 2''' normally spawn in groups. *Long range towers, such as the [[Ranger|Outlaw]], are recommended as they can be placed out of range of the '''Tank 2's''' ''Molten Rock Throw''. *The [[Freezer]]'s ''Ice Drop'' can stop the '''Tank 2''' in its tracks. **However, this does not prevent the '''Tank 2''' from attacking. ==Sounds== {{Sounds|{{pe| {| class{{=}}"article-table align-center" style{{=}}"width:750px; margin:0 auto;" |- ! style{{=}}"width:30%;" |Sound ! style{{=}}"width:70%;" |Description |- ! colspan{{=}}"2" |Abilities |- |[[File:Tank2Grab.ogg]] |When the '''Tank 2''' performs ''Molten Rock Throw'' ability |- ! colspan{{=}}"2" |Death |- |[[File:CarrierScream.ogg]] |When the '''Tank 2''' dies |} }}}} ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Trailers}} OFFICIAL Tower Defense Simulator Trailer 2|'''Tank 2''' in the game trailer. }} ==Trivia== *The arms of this enemy were taken from the {{RLinkC|299|Superhero}} package in the Roblox catalog. **They also resembled the [[w:c:r2d:Tank|Tank]] from ''R2D'' and were likely a reference to the game. **The '''Tank 2''' was also based on the [[w:c:left4dead:The Tank|Tank]] from ''Left 4 Dead''. *The [[Bulwark]], an enemy added five years later after its removal, has a similar appearance to the '''Tank 2'''. ==Update History== *'''30 June 2019''' - [[BETA v1.3|BETA v1.3.1]] **'''Tank 2''' added. *'''13 October 2019''' - [[Release v1.0|Release v1.0.0]] **'''Tank 2''' removed. {{Normal|[[Boomer 2]]|Wave 43|Tank 2|Wave 46|[[Molten Boss]]|Wave 50}} {{ZombieNavBox}}
